callouts.text: 1 · Click the violet Async region. Press Communication — cards go Simple, cables go Summary, and the DRAW group appears.
2 · Press Service, drag Mission's card onto Robot's. No ports, no port dots. Repeat with Action. Then Stream, Camera → Mission.
3 · CABLES › Split. One arrow becomes its protocol legs, each tagged with its phase. Summary puts them back — it always rides the request, or the goal.
4 · Press Dataflow. Cards go Port, cables go Data, and every socket is back on a left or right lane — Dataflow has no top or bottom edge.
5 · ARROW › Curve, then Straight. Every cable in the region changes shape at once, and one undo puts them all back. A single cable still takes its own shape from its selection menu.

6 · CARD › P, then press and HOLD a port dot and drag it to any of the four edges. Or select the port and use the inspector's Block edge control. Hold still first — moving straight away draws a cable.

PASS WHEN every arrow starts and ends on a port — there is no line between two card middles any more. Ports on a wall spread across the whole wall rather than clustering in one section, and no label is struck through by another. ARROW changes every cable in the region; a single selected cable still changes on its own. A socket dragged in Communication stays put when you flip to Dataflow and back.
